items.title: GEN-1.5: Embodied Foundation Models are One-Shot Learners
items.abstract: GEN-1.5 is an embodied foundation model that learns new closed-loop robotic skills from a single 3-12 second sensorimotor demonstration through physical prompting, without gradient updates. The model supports compositional prompting, zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, human-to-robot imitation, and few-shot adaptation with 1-10 gradient steps. Generalist reports 59% average success for one-shot in-context learning and 83% after ten-step adaptation across ten physical manipulation tasks.
